answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 26 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The bridge register is checked at draw time, karst lists the eligible set, and sable seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 26 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Collateral of 75 dollars is at risk. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
